主要内容: On February 10, 2014, Insperity, Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial and operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2013. The press release was included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The filing was submitted to the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and included details about the company's financial performance. The press release provided insights into the company's operations and financial condition for the specified periods. The filing was signed by Daniel D. Herink, Senior Vice President of Legal, General Counsel, and Secretary of Insperity, Inc., on February 10, 2014. The document also included an exhibit index listing the press release as Exhibit 99.1.
